title: A listening practice before a performance
intro: The work begins with attention: to your question, your language, and the context that makes it yours.

sections.heading: No script for your life
sections.body: Sessions are shaped around what you bring, not forced into a fixed interpretation.

sections.heading: Cultural respect
sections.body: We treat ancestral language and cultural memory with humility rather than spectacle.

sections.heading: A practical close
sections.body: Every conversation ends by returning to what you can choose next.
